scope: Nested numeric CAST Fields and changed numeric/math inspections only
row_encoding: Recursive Spark Row/tuple values are JSON arrays; scalar integer/string leaves use the frozen encoder; DOUBLE leaves use IEEE-754 big-endian hex, with nan normalized.

cases.sql: SELECT named_struct('source',v,'cast',CAST(v AS INT),'try',TRY_CAST(v AS INT)) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=6
cases.purpose: Nested required source, CAST and TRY child Fields with source metadata

cases.sql: SELECT named_struct('cast',CAST(v AS INT),'try',TRY_CAST(v AS INT)) AS r FROM narrow_nullable WHERE id=14
cases.purpose: Nested nullable CAST and TRY Fields and NULL values

cases.sql: SELECT id FROM narrow_required WHERE v IN (CAST(4294967297L AS INT)) ORDER BY id
cases.purpose: Numeric-literal conversion and membership inspection path

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(v AS INT) / CAST(4294967296L AS INT) AS r FROM narrow_required WHERE id=12
cases.purpose: Mode-sensitive cast and arithmetic inspection/error priority
